Cloud Infrastructure Network Engineer – Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.
This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Cloud Infrastructure Network Engineer
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $100,000–$115,000 Annually
Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking a Cloud Infrastructure Network Engineer to design, deploy, and operate cloud networking infrastructure across one or more major cloud providers. The role covers VPC/VNet design, hybrid connectivity, transit topologies, edge networking, DNS, and the security controls that make cloud networking reliable and safe at scale. The ideal candidate combines deep traditional networking knowledge with cloud-native networking patterns, has built production cloud networks at meaningful scale, and brings strong automation discipline to networking work. In this role you will work closely with cross-functional partners — product, design, engineering, operations, and business stakeholders — to translate ambiguous requirements into well-engineered solutions, and will be expected to raise the bar through code review, design review, and mentorship of more junior engineers. The successful candidate brings strong engineering discipline, a clear communication style, and a track record of shipping meaningful work that holds up well in production.

Required Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Networking, or a related field.
Five or more years of experience in networking, with significant time on cloud networking.
Deep hands-on experience with networking on at least one major cloud provider.
Strong understanding of routing, switching, BGP, and modern networking fundamentals.
Hands-on experience with hybrid connectivity (Direct Connect, ExpressRoute, or equivalents).
Experience with infrastructure-as-code for cloud networking, especially Terraform.
Strong understanding of cloud security and network controls.
Familiarity with Kubernetes networking and service mesh fundamentals.
Strong troubleshooting and packet-level analysis skills.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
Preferred Qualifications
Cloud networking specialty certifications (AWS Advanced Networking, Azure Network Engineer).
Experience with multi-cloud networking and cloud-to-cloud connectivity.
Familiarity with SD-WAN platforms and SASE architectures.
Experience with eBPF-based networking tools.
Exposure to regulated industries with strict network segmentation requirements.
How to Apply
Would you like to know more about this opportunity? For immediate consideration, please send your resume to hilda@bvteck.com
